verdict.rationale: Operating an identity and device-management platform through natural-language commands is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents programmatic control through REST APIs and a PowerShell module, plus directory support for 'agent' identities. None of that is a natural-language command interface, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
